noAccess: You don't have access to users. Ask an administrator to grant you the permissions you need.
description: Accounts of the platform with their roles and profiles. A teacher profile lets a user teach lessons and join a department, a student profile puts them into a student group. You can edit only users ranked below you.
lockedSelf: This is your account: edit it in your profile
lockedRank: This user ranks at or above you

form.createDescription: Create an account and pass the email and the initial password on to the user: they sign in with them and can change the password in their profile. Turn on a teacher or student profile to let them teach lessons or see the lessons of their group.
form.editDescription: Update the user's details, roles and profiles. Turning a profile off removes the user from their department or student group.
